title: Unparented upstream items BI-PF-1246/BI-PF-1247 failed the blocking backlog-epic gate
body: BI-PF-1246 and BI-PF-1247 (created 2026-10-10) had no epic, so the blocking fast gate backlog_epic_audit failed on develop; they are not in _BASELINE.

rcca.root_cause: Items were created without attaching an epic (the creator path skipped epic attachment); the gate's _BASELINE is a hardcoded global, so any later unparented item fails it.
rcca.corrective: Attached BI-PF-1246/BI-PF-1247 to the CI/CD & Gates epic (BI-PF-1243); gate passes.
rcca.preventive: Creators must attach an epic on create (core.backlog auto_epic); grooming re-homes Unscoped children.
